spec_match.rationale: Implements explainer use case 3 with the documented question types: two booleans (string 'true'/'false' labels with confidence) and a numeric-labelled score whose expectedScore the page reads as the weighted severity.

interactive.rationale: Editable draft textarea and a check button that runs the real multi-question decide(); three answer cards update from genuine results only.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises boolean + score types, confidence thresholds, and an honest unavailable panel; all present.

edge_cases.rationale: Branches for empty drafts, unavailable devices, download progress, missing question ids in the result (reported raw), and absence; the 0.8 confidence threshold gates nudges exactly as the explainer recommends.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5155080092385280 and the explainer use case.

conformance.rationale: Covered by the feature suite's surface and enum assertions; the page's absent branch mirrors the suite's honest 0/6 on 141.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP driver: check attempt threw ReferenceError rendered verbatim, answer cards reset to the labelled unavailable state (never a fake verdict), schema JSON correct, console clean, 0px overflow both classes. Partial: the real three-answer path requires a provider absent from this container.

telemetry_health.rationale: Distinct asserts for decided, unavailable, shape-drift and absent branches; no noisy rejection paths (model?.destroy() guarded).

design_system.rationale: Tokens only; warn/ok answers are rose/emerald on paper and always carry explanatory text, not colour alone.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled textarea with described hint, native controls, answer cards are text paragraphs under mono headings, single polite output narrates the run.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Harness ok/ok; single-column card stack, textarea resizes vertically only, no horizontal overflow at 360px.

openQuestions.title: Validate boolean label strings and expectedScore weighting on a real provider
openQuestions.detail: The page assumes boolean answers arrive as string labels 'true'/'false' and that numeric score labels produce a weighted expectedScore (per the explainer and IDL). With a provider present, confirm both assumptions and the probabilities record shape keyed by option label.

guidanceConsulted.query: on-device AI form validation privacy download gating
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep inference local and explain it; gate downloads on user gestures via create(); destroy sessions; treat outputs as untrusted text.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Copy states the draft never leaves the page; create() runs only from the click (a user gesture) with a progress monitor; destroy() in finally; textContent rendering throughout.

guidanceConsulted.query: form guardrail warnings that do not block submission
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Advisory validation should announce via polite regions and never rely on colour; destructive consequences need explicit confirmation.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Warnings are advisory text in the cards plus one polite status; the page documents that model confidence is not execution authorization.

summary: Explainer use case 3 live: a three-question (boolean×2 + score) pre-submission check running the real parallel decide() workflow with confidence-gated nudges, honest unavailable state, and verbatim platform errors. Verified with the repo headless-Chromium-141 CDP driver (no chrome-devtools-mcp here): absence branch exercised, console clean, ok/ok responsive.
